candidate_inventory.authorization_join: candidate conditions must contain at least one estimand pair authorized by estimand_identification.csv

observation_contract.baseline_exclusion_reason: relative outcomes equal one by construction at the normalization measurement
observation_contract.model_construction_population: all eligible positive-horizon observations from authorized support-member cells
observation_contract.evaluation_population: eligible observations inside the recorded support interval

model.name: hierarchical_joint_condition_trajectory
model.model_equation: log_outcome = population_intercept + condition_intercept_deviation + (population_horizon_slope + condition_horizon_slope_deviation) * scaled_horizon + cell_intercept + cell_horizon_slope * scaled_horizon
model.condition_intercept_slope_independence_r: The number of modeled conditions can be small within an authorized connected component. Fixing the condition-level intercept-slope correlation at zero avoids adding a weakly identified covariance parameter while retaining separate partial-pooling scales. This restriction must remain explicit when interpreting trajectories.

predictive_assessment.posterior_predictive_equal_cell_weightin: reduce observations within each cell to the numpy linear median, then calculate every registered statistic across the resulting equally weighted cell-level medians

reason_codes.NO_POSITIVE_WIDTH_CONTINUOUS_EVALUATION_: The authorized comparison has no positive-width range over which a continuous difference trajectory can be reported.
reason_codes.CONDITIONS_NOT_PRESENT_IN_CANDIDATE: The candidate does not contain both estimand conditions.
reason_codes.NO_SHARED_AUTHORIZED_RANGE: The candidate support and estimand-permitted ranges do not have a positive-width intersection.
reason_codes.REFERENCE_POSTERIOR_NOT_ANALYTICALLY_AVA: The reference posterior did not satisfy the registered analytical qualification requirements.
reason_codes.NONFINITE_TRAJECTORY_DERIVATION: The requested trajectory quantity could not be derived as a finite value from the posterior draws.

amendment.reason: Amends Bayesian modeling policy version 1.19 to (i) bind every published report to the executing implementation SHA-256, (ii) enforce exact nested cache-identity equality including a recomputed identity digest and directory-name check, (iii) validate the complete set of runtime-driving predictive_assessment, trajectory_reporting, analytical_qualification and observation-order fields, (iv) register the already-emitted CACHE_TERMINAL_FAILURE reason code, (v) require per-candidate failed-gate reason reporting for diagnostic-only candidates, and (vi) reconcile admissibility reason counts and per-operation prior-predictive review requirements against the candidate table. No prior, likelihood, threshold, candidate inventory, support domain, sampler setting, or qualification gate is altered. The 1.17 source posterior cache remains the sole source of draws under the registered import contract; no new sampling is performed.
